wiki.title: Mitch Whitaker
wiki.extract: Mitchum Addison Whitaker (born May 12, 1993) is an American attorney and politician who has served as a member of the Kentucky House of Representatives since January 2025. A member of the Republican Party, Whitaker represents Kentucky's 94th House district, which includes Letcher County as well as part of Harlan and Pike counties.
